title: 1911 superconductor discovery as a model for UAP behaviour as emergent macroscopic quantum effects

tellings.quote: so what did we learn in 1911 we learned that when a material breaks the laws of physics when anything does it's actually probably because it's an emergent property or an immersion phenomenon right of underlying strange quantum mechanics that are going on

plain: The 1911 discovery of superconductivity by the physicist Onnes might explain how UAP, the newer official term for UFOs, seem to break the laws of physics. That is the argument of the researcher Deep Prasad, who tells Michels that superconductors, materials that carry electricity with no resistance, looked impossible at first. They turned out to be an emergent effect of strange quantum mechanics underneath. Prasad, giving no named source, suggests UAP behaviour could be the same kind of large-scale quantum effect, which would make it explainable physics rather than magic.
